verdict.rationale: Codex cloud tasks support delegating a full build/test/PR-creation workflow (isolated cloud env, run tasks, inspect diff, open a pull request) matching the 'build, test, demo, review' loop, and docs explicitly describe configuring repo setup/tools for tests. However, community evidence raises real doubts about reliability and consistency of agentic execution ('struggles with almost anything', rate limits interrupting flow, agentic weaknesses vs competitors), so delivery is credible but with significant caveats.
